biggest_catch: You must route $500+ of real payroll or government direct deposits (not Venmo, transfers, or tax refunds) into Varo within 45 days of opening — Varo alone decides what counts.
catches: Requires $500 or more in Qualifying Direct Deposits within the first 45 days of account opening — a real hurdle for anyone without payroll/government direct deposit to move.

Qualifying Direct Deposits are electronic deposits of a paycheck, pension, or government benefits via ACH; tax refunds, stimulus payments, Venmo, Varo-to-Anyone, and transfers using a Varo routing number do NOT count.
'Varo, in its sole discretion, will determine whether a deposit is a Qualifying Deposit' — borderline deposits can be disqualified with no appeal stated.
New customers only — anyone who has previously been a Varo customer (Varo Bank, N.A. or Varo Money, Inc.) is excluded; the account must be open and in good standing at payout.
A limited-time $200 variant (usually $100) ends September 30, 2026 — the standard ongoing offer is $100.
Each Varo customer can refer at most 5 people per calendar year; if your referrer already hit the cap, their link is dead and you get $0 — confirm the link is active before opening.

c1.evidence: Varo Bank, N.A. — real operating nationally-chartered bank; official referral pages on the varomoney.com domain.

c2.evidence: Official varomoney.com referral pages state a concrete '$100' bonus with the $500-in-45-days direct-deposit condition; the official Referral Program Policy document details qualifying deposits and payout timing.

c3.evidence: No fee to open or enroll; Varo advertises 'No monthly account fees or minimums.' The requirement is routing direct deposits, not a payment to Varo.

c4.evidence: Official varomoney.com: 'We'll give you $100 when you join Varo and receive $500 or more in qualifying direct deposits within 45 days of account opening.'

eligibility: New Varo customers only (never a Varo Bank, N.A. or Varo Money, Inc. customer). Join through an active referrer link; receive $500+ in Qualifying Direct Deposits within 45 days of account opening; account open with balance >= $0 and in good standing at payout.

steps: Get an ACTIVE Varo referral link from a current Varo customer — each customer can refer only 5 people per calendar year, so confirm their link still works before you start.
Click the referral link and open a new Varo Bank Account (subject to approval); applying won't impact your credit score.

Within 45 days of account opening, receive $500 or more in Qualifying Direct Deposits: electronic ACH deposits of a paycheck, pension, or government benefits (Social Security, unemployment). Venmo, Varo-to-Anyone, tax refunds, and stimulus payments do NOT count.
Keep the account open with an available balance of $0.00 or more and in good standing.
If qualified, the $100 referral bonus is deposited into your Varo account within 15 business days (policy document allows up to 30 business days from the qualifying deposit).
timing: Bonus deposited within 15 business days of qualifying per the referral pages (the policy document states within 30 business days of receipt of the qualifying direct deposit).
